Disposizione dei tasti-nota sulle tre ri:
Layout of the note keys on the three rows:
- Chromatic: 12 semitones per row, one octave each (3 octaves in total).
- Scale of the key (diatonic/pentatonic/blues): only the notes of the chosen scale - requires a valid Key in the main toolbar, otherwise it falls back to chromatic; the shorter the scale, the more octaves it covers.
- Jankó: whole-tone rows offset by a semitone, isomorphic (same shape = same interval everywhere) - covers 2 octaves, independent of the key.
Distanza in campioni tra una stima e la: Distance in samples between one estimate and the next. Smaller = more time resolution but slower analysis.
